name: Thinblood Resistance
text:
**Thinblood Resistance**: Darkborn are accustomed to torture at the hands of their drow forebears and gain a +2 racial bonus on Fortitude saves against poison and disease, including magical diseases. Darkborn also gain the poison use ability and never risk poisoning themselves when applying poison to a weapon.

This replaces elven immunities.
